name: Teia Events Contract
description: On-chain registry of the community events showcased on the Teia events page and in the header events dropdown — exhibitions, drops, galleries and initiatives, each linking to its own site or to a Teia search. It replaces a hardcoded list in the Teia front end. Each event is identified by an auto-incrementing integer event_id and stores its current IPFS/Arweave CID, a hidden flag, a version counter (version_count) and an optional proposer. The version history itself is NOT stored on-chain: every mutation emits a complete version record (tag event_created for a new event, event_updated for a new version, each carrying the event id, CID, hidden flag, version number, editor, proposer and timestamp), from which indexers reconstruct the full append-only history — this avoids the unbounded storage burn of a per-version big_map. The event's title, subtitle, description, link, screenshot and banner colour live off-chain in the event's CID content. Because the front end embeds each event's link in an iframe on teia.art, the registry is DAO-curated rather than self-serve: there is no per-entry owner, and only moderators and linked multisig users can create (create_event), edit (update_event) or hide/unhide (set_event_hidden) an entry. Teia token holders take part through a proposal queue: propose_event registers a proposed CID (charging propose_fee, forwarded to the fee recipient and defaulting to 0), which a moderator or multisig user then approves (approve_proposal, creating the event and recording the proposer for attribution only) or rejects (reject_proposal). An approved proposer gains no rights over the resulting entry. Creating, editing, hiding, approving and rejecting accept no tez. Multisig governance covers pause, the linked multisig/moderator/token addresses, the token id, the proposal fee, the fee recipient and contract metadata updates; governance proposals require a minimum number of votes and expire after a configurable time, both fetched from the linked multisig contract.

expansion.string: The caller is not authorized to perform this action
No event exists for the given event id
The operation does not accept tez transfers
The provided tez amount does not match the required propose_fee for propose_event
The caller does not hold any Teia tokens and cannot propose an event
The given proposal id does not exist
The proposal has already been approved or rejected and cannot be resolved again
The given governance proposal id does not exist
The governance proposal has already been executed and cannot be voted on or executed again
The governance proposal did not receive enough positive votes to be executed
The governance proposal has expired and can no longer be voted on or executed
Failed to call the is_user view on the linked multisig contract
Failed to call the is_moderator view on the linked moderator contract
Failed to call the get_balance view on the linked Teia token contract
Failed to call the get_minimum_votes view on the linked multisig contract
Failed to call the get_expiration_time view on the linked multisig contract
